summary: Several proofs rest on undocumented definitional equality (bare `erw` and terminal `rfl` across the TangentSpace/product-model synonym and ContinuousLinearEquiv wrappers), and the contMDiff proof duplicates two component-smoothness blocks and the IsManifold upgrade instead of factoring them.
